blocks.html: Prior to erecting, jumping, or dismantling the tower crane, or other crane type the commissioner specifies by rule, the master or tower crane rigger shall certify in the meeting log, described in Section 3319.8.6, that the rigger foreman and all other members of the "jumping crew" and back-up personnel have satisfactorily completed all training requirements.
